claims: New Zealand defeated Chile 4-1 on March 30, 2026.
The match was a FIFA Series friendly match.
The match was at Eden Park, Auckland.
The All Whites achieved their first-ever win against South American opposition.
Chile's Dario Osorio was sent off with two yellow cards.
Kosta Barbarouses scored for New Zealand in the 31st minute.
Elijah Just scored for New Zealand in the 40th minute.
Jesse Randall scored for New Zealand in the 60th minute.
Ben Waine scored for New Zealand in the 71st minute.
Dario Osorio scored for Chile in the 27th minute.
The match was New Zealand's final home game before the 2026 World Cup.
New Zealand played without captain Chris Wood.
Chile defeated New Zealand 2-1 in a U-20 matchup in September 2025.
The 2026 match was part of the FIFA Series
